title.narrative: Piloting a whole school approach to mental health in schools

description.narrative:
The project aims to raise awareness and transform the practices of education staff with regards the importance of well-being and promotion of a school learning environment conducive to good mental health. Support measures entail a thorough review of existing initiatives, enhancing the skills of education staff through specialized training, sharing good practices with national and international experts, and integrating Social Emotional Learning (SEL) skills into school curricula and educational practices.
Moreover, the project intends to emphasize community-wide awareness and mobilization, involving staff, learners, parents, and professionals from child and adolescent support networks, all centred around the mental health of learners. The project will develop a cross-sectoral collaboration framework among educational and pedagogical staff, health and social service personnel within the National Education system, and care partners, with continuous monitoring and evaluation to ensure intervention effectiveness.
In the long term, this initiative aims to promote a holistic mental health care, fostering a safe and inclusive environment for all stakeholders in the educational community.
